name: Fathom
description: Fathom is an AI meeting notetaker that joins video calls to automatically record and transcribe conversations, then generates instant call summaries, action items, and CRM-ready notes immediately afterward, so sales and customer-facing teams can stay present in the conversation instead of typing notes.
best_for: Individuals and sales or customer-facing teams that want free, unlimited automatic meeting transcription and summaries, with CRM sync, deal tracking, and coaching scorecards available on paid team plans.
features: Automatic recording, transcription, and instant AI-generated call summaries delivered immediately after each meeting
Bot-free capture (in beta) alongside traditional meeting-bot recording, for Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams
"Ask Fathom" search across past conversations, plus a conversational meeting assistant on paid plans
Automatic CRM field sync and a Deal View that pushes call data into Salesforce and HubSpot on the Business plan
AI Scorecards and coaching metrics for reviewing call performance on the Business plan
Desktop app plus integrations with Slack, Notion, Asana, ChatGPT, and Claude for working with meeting data
Clips, playlists, and global search across recorded calls, with team collaboration via comments, folders, and keyword alerts on the Team plan
Public API and MCP server access for custom integrations

pricing.starting_price: $16/user/month, billed annually (Premium plan) — Free plan also available

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Free forever. Includes unlimited recordings and transcriptions (choice of bot-free beta or bot capture), instant AI call summaries, and clips/playlists/search across calls. Covered by Fathom's 90-day guarantee.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: $20/user/month if billed monthly. No seat minimum. Adds advanced call summaries, AI-generated action items, a conversational meeting assistant, and a custom meeting bot.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: $19/user/month if billed monthly. Minimum 2 users. Adds global search across calls, meeting-highlight playlists, and team collaboration via comments, folders, and keyword alerts.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: $34/user/month if billed monthly. Minimum 2 users. Adds CRM field sync, Deal View, coaching metrics/AI scorecards, and custom call summaries.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Custom pricing via sales ("Talk to sales"). Adds a Launch Assist onboarding program, org-wide security controls, SSO/SCIM provisioning, custom data retention, and a dedicated success manager.

pros: Genuine free-forever plan with unlimited recordings and transcriptions and instant AI summaries, not just a time-limited trial
States SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, and HIPAA compliance plus SSO/SCIM support directly on its homepage
Publishes exact per-seat pricing, both monthly and annual, for every self-serve tier (Premium, Team, Business)
cons: Team and Business plans require a 2-user minimum, so a single-person buyer pays the pricier individual Premium rate instead
CRM field sync, Deal View, and AI coaching scorecards are reserved for the Business tier and above
Enterprise-only features (org-wide security controls, SSO/SCIM, custom data retention) require contacting sales with no published price

faq.question: Does Fathom have a free plan?
faq.answer: Yes. Fathom's Free plan is described as "Free forever" and includes unlimited recordings and transcriptions plus instant AI call summaries, per its pricing page.

faq.question: How much does Fathom cost?
faq.answer: On annual billing, Premium is $16/user/month, Team is $15/user/month (2-user minimum), and Business is $25/user/month (2-user minimum). Monthly billing is higher across all tiers, and Enterprise is custom-priced.

faq.question: Is Fathom SOC 2 compliant?
faq.answer: Fathom's homepage states "SOC 2 Type II | GDPR | HIPAA Compliant | SSO / SCIM" as part of its trust messaging.

alternatives.name: Otter.ai
alternatives.description: An AI conversational knowledge engine that automatically transcribes meetings, interviews, and conversations into searchable summaries with action items and speaker identification.
alternatives.best_for: Teams and individuals across sales, education, and media wanting automatic transcription with a chat-based search assistant.

alternatives.name: Fireflies.ai
alternatives.description: An AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, and summarizes conversations across video-conferencing and dialer platforms, with CRM and workflow automation.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting a meeting notetaker with broad app integrations and voice-analytics add-ons alongside a free plan.

alternatives.name: Gong
alternatives.description: A revenue intelligence platform that captures and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk, coach reps, and inform forecasting.
alternatives.best_for: Sales organizations wanting deal-risk scoring and org-wide forecasting built on top of captured conversations, not just per-call notes.
strengths: Rep coaching grounded in real calls
